supersedes: probe_questions_v1 (60 items); v1's items are all retained in order
why: The constitution supplies 50 questions and that is its whole supply (10 traits x 5).
At n=110 the cross-elicitation AUROC gate was estimated on 33 held-out items and the
best variant cleared the 0.75 floor by 0.005 - an order of magnitude inside the
estimator's own standard error (~0.05-0.08 at that n). It passed honestly and it was
not solid. More items is the legitimate way to firm that up; lowering the floor is not,
and DEFAULT_AUROC_FLOOR is pre-registered precisely so it cannot be.
NOT ADDED TO THE CONSTITUTION ON PURPOSE. constitution_questions() in
implant/generators/demos.py feeds few_shot ICL prefixes and the CAA contrast pairs the
steering vectors are extracted from, so adding there would change what those organisms
serve and invalidate artifacts already pushed to the HF org. It also fed sft_demos
training data until that method was deleted on 2026-09-03. This bank is read by the
probe trainer and by nothing else.
NOT UNDER data/personas/ EITHER: discover_personas treats any dotless-stem *.json there
as a constitution, so a file at that path becomes a persona named 'probe_questions'.
SHARED ACROSS PERSONAS, not per-persona: control 1 of plan 2.3c is the same questions on
every arm and every elicitation. These are everyday prompts carrying no trait wording,
so the only thing differing between the classes is the elicitation - which is the point.
A question naming the trait would make answers differ by TOPIC as well as disposition.
DISJOINT FROM THE EVAL BANKS by construction (data/eval_prompts/**). Training a probe on
items it is later scored on is train-set accuracy wearing the clothes of a result.
